locationAllocationRules.intersection: 9 G1 intersections x 12 events = 108 intersection-bound events, interleaved by round so each location has old and recent history.
locationAllocationRules.road: 6 selected G1 roads x 6 events = 36 road-bound events, interleaved in the first six rounds.
locationAllocationRules.resolverInput: roadName uses only G1 canonical names or sourced aliases.

eventTypeAllocationRules: Six G2-covered canonical event types cycle by location index and local sequence, yielding 24 events per type and at least two event types per intersection.
riskAllocationRules: Chinese risk levels cycle by global sequence across low/medium/high/major ranges; scores are finite integers between 24 and 96.
statusAllocationRules: Existing EVENT_STATUSES cycle by global sequence and include terminal and UNCLOSED statuses.
durationRules: All formal G3-A events use finite positive duration seconds from a deterministic fixed formula. NULL-duration persistence is not part of this pack and remains covered by Wave C historical context tests.
timeOfDayAllocationRules: Four local-time buckets are represented by UTC timestamps that map to Asia/Shanghai night, morning, afternoon, and evening buckets.
optionalContextFieldPolicy: Formal events intentionally omit isMainRoad, nearbySchool, and nearbyHospital. Those fields are not needed by HistoricalTrafficService and must not convert G1 road/POI geography into synthetic event facts.
aliasSelectionRule: Road-level events cycle through G1 road canonical names and sourced aliases; intersection events use G1 intersection canonical names.
statisticalRealityBoundary: Validation-oriented distribution only. Frequencies, weather, risk, duration, and time-of-day are not real Qiantang traffic statistics.
